breadcrumb: Wire up Deploy App TAK Servers via a Federation Hub (IaC)

blocks.html:
Deploy App artifacts

From pvarki/docker-rasenmaeher-integration:

  • takserver/templates/CoreConfig.tpl — the templated TAK Server config: federation already enabled (v2 9001, token auth 9002, MFDT on), fed-truststore.jks, the <auth default="ldap" x509groups="true"> block with the tak_<group> LDAP mapping, and the .pref file filter.
  • takserver/scripts/firstrun_rm.sh — builds takserver.jks from the RASENMAEHER-issued cert and the truststore from /ca_public/{root,intermediate,miniwerk}_ca.pem, then copies it to fed-truststore.jks (the trust-injection hook).
  • takintegration — enrolls the TAK Server as a product and signs its cert via …/api/v1/product/sign_csr/mtls.
  • Keycloak, kc_client_init, and the RASENMAEHER LDAP backend — the source of the tak_<group> groups.

Official guides

  • Federation Hub Configuration Guide (public release) — ports (9100/9101/9102/9103), federation-hub-broker.yml and federation-hub-ui.yml, federation-hub-manager.jar (authorized users), Keycloak admin OAuth, and the policy.
  • TAK Server Configuration Guide — §12 Federation, the CoreConfig.xml <federation> schema (including <federation-outgoing>), and the recommendation to keep a separate federation truststore.

Companion guides (this site)

  • Federation Hub — the concepts behind the policy graph, CA groups, edges, and group filtering.
  • Integrating to TAK Server — the Marti API and group model used by the verification probes.
  • Wire up two Federation Hubs (IaC) — connecting hub domains, for larger setups with many groups of servers.

Open item to confirm

The Federation Hub policy artifact (its persisted file path and schema, or the policy-manager apply endpoint), referenced from federation-hub-broker.yml. Confirm it once for your build, then policy generation is just another templated artifact.

Status and scope

Draft / proposed design, not yet demoed. Based on Deploy App's docker-rasenmaeher-integration templates and the public TAK Server and Federation Hub configuration guides. Civilian; no TAK-MIL content. Confirm ports and paths against the versions you run.
